purpose: Two-stage Asp272-mediated HG1 shuttle, construction pilot, not a barrier
stage1: Couple OG1-C attack to HG1 transfer OG1 -> Asp272 OD1
stage2: Hold attack coordinate and transfer the same HG1 Asp272 OD1 -> N-terminal N
stage_transition: Only after converged, target-tracking stage1 and Asp-H/covalent TI1 gate
QM_region_and_charge: Unchanged 98 real atoms + 8 links, charge -2 singlet
water: No new water; original full solvent retained
optimizer: Native Sander DL-FIND Cartesian LBFGS, full active system, analytic gradients
trajectory: ntwx=5 DL-FIND evaluation callbacks plus exact endpoints; trial evaluations are included
MM_restraints: Retain original reference and force constant 10 kcal/mol/A2
DLFIND_hard_constraint_disang: Omitted; use ordinary NMR harmonic DISANG only
failure_policy: Stop, preserve evidence, do not relax acceptance silently
